P1.2.text: Our products move material, clean infrastructure, and protect the communities where we work and live.

P1.4.text: TOGETHER WE TRULY MAKE A DIFFERENCE

P1.5.text: A COMPANY FOCUSED ON CREATING VALUE

P1.6.text: Federal Signal manufactures a broad range of equipment engineered to improve, enhance and safeguard communities, companies and their infrastructure around the world.

P2.2.text: Serving our Customers for Over 120 Years

P2.3.text: The Federal Signal story begins at the dawn of the 20th century, when the Gilchrist brothers founded Federal Electric Company, a manufacturer of electric store signs in Chicago.

P2.4.text: An Organization Committed to Creating a Cleaner Environment for All of Us

P2.5.text: Federal Signal operates multiple principal manufacturing facilities around the world while directly managing over 40 service centers. Our customers are also supported through a network of thousands of distributor and dealer locations.

P2.6.text: Corporate Headquarters Downers Grove, Illinois Fayette, Alabama Leeds, Alabama Tempe, Arizona Long Beach, California

P2.11.text: Albany, New York Rochester, New York High Point, North Carolina Monroe, North Carolina Rugby, North Dakota Williston, North Dakota Toledo, Ohio Hadley, Pennsylvania Saegertown, Pennsylvania Lexington, South Carolina

P2.13.text: Richmond, Virginia Snohomish, Washington Tacoma, Washington Calgary, Alberta, Canada Edmonton, Alberta, Canada Nisku, Alberta, Canada Winnipeg, Manitoba, Canada Halifax, Nova Scotia, Canada

P2.14.text: Courtland, Ontario, Canada Hamilton, Ontario, Canada Innisfil, Ontario, Canada London, Ontario, Canada Ottawa, Ontario, Canada Toronto, Ontario, Canada Montreal, Quebec, Canada

P2.15.text: Newcastle, United Kingdom Katowice, Poland Barcelona, Spain Madrid, Spain

P2.17.text: As an organization, we are relentless in our commitment to our customers to build and deliver equipment of unmatched quality that moves material, cleans infrastructure, and protects the communities where we live and work.

P2.18.text: Federal Signal’s equipment keeps society moving, which means we have a duty to help solve the trickiest problems of the future in a sustainable and ethical manner. With every product we manufacture and every service we provide, we remain steadfast in our commitment to always do what is right.

P2.19.text: Beyond these basic values, we believe in:

P2.20.text: We believe “why” is the most important question of all, and we encourage each other to ask it.

P2.21.text: Our commitment to developing our workforce means that changing business conditions will not impede the accomplishment of our mission.

P2.22.text: While we are free to choose different tactics along the way, we will not waver from our strategy, our value proposition, and our commitment to delighting our customers.

P2.23.text: With candor and coherence, we are willing to speak our minds.

P2.24.text: We care deeply about our customers, and about our fellow employees.

P2.25.text: Without the belief that we are likely to succeed, we guarantee that we will not.

P2.26.text: Serving the Needs of a Changing World

P2.27.text: Our story is one of more than a century of innovation and growth.

P2.28.text: The Federal Electric Co., a manufacturer of electric signs is incorporated in Illinois by brothers John and James Gilchrist and partner John Goehst.

P2.29.text: The young company diversifies its growing product line by purchasing the patents for an electrically operated siren.

P2.30.text: Federal Electric comes under the ownership of Commonwealth Edison, becoming part of the utility empire of Samuel Insull.

P2.31.text: The company becomes independent again and sales continue to grow as new applications for its signs and signals are developed. During World War II, the company provides sirens to warn Londoners of incoming air raids, and, after the war, its signs are used to illuminate Las Vegas casinos.

P2.32.text: The company is renamed the Federal Sign and Signal Corporation

P1.2.text: Your Children's Safety is our Business.

P1.3.text: 250 Years of America. A Century of Blue Bird.

P1.4.text: As we look toward the America 250 milestone, Blue Bird is reflecting on nearly 100 years of helping build an American institution of safety and reliability.

P1.5.text: For almost a century, we have safely connected millions of students to their education every day. As the only U.S.-owned and operated school bus manufacturer, we are proud to be a featured part of the America 250 story, leading the industry into the next century with zero-emission technology and manufacturing innovation.

P1.6.text: We aren’t just part of history; we are Driving the Future.

P1.7.text: In low and zero-emission school buses.

P1.8.text: By choosing our state-of-the-art buses, schools can not only reduce their carbon footprint, but also make a positive impact on student health, safety, and overall well-being. With our innovative technologies and cutting-edge designs, we are proud to be at the forefront of the green transportation movement.

P1.9.text: The Blue Bird Vision Electric School Bus is the Coolest Thing Made in Georgia

P1.10.text: Blue Bird is proud to announce that our Vision Electric school bus won the 2026 Coolest Thing Made in Georgia competition, hosted by the Georgia Chamber of Commerce. This honor recognizes the Vision Electric’s innovative, all-electric approach to student transportation and the expertise, craftsmanship and dedication of the Blue Bird team that designs and builds it in Georgia. By combining advanced technology with a commitment to safe, reliable and sustainable transportation, the Vision Electric represents the future of student mobility—and the strength of Georgia manufacturing.

P1.11.text: A recognized technology leader of school buses with nearly 100 years of history and experience.

P1.18.text: Prepare your fleet for the next school year with a summer school bus maintenance checklist covering safety instructions, technician tips and essential replacement parts from Blue Bird dealers.
